pf2e-pending-damage.title: Pending Damage

enabled.name: Enable Pending Damage
enabled.hint: Coordinate chat and pending-window damage applications through an active GM. Requires Toolbelt Target Helper. All clients must enable this module.

protection.name: Duplicate Protection
protection.hint: Coordinate each damage application through a connected GM so a roll can't be applied to a target twice. Turn this off only if applying damage fails: chat buttons then work exactly as in PF2e and Toolbelt, and the pending window applies damage directly, without protection.

showWindow.name: Show Pending Damage Window
showWindow.hint: Collect new damage for tokens you own. Disabling the window keeps duplicate protection active in chat.

repeat.title: Apply Damage Again?
repeat.content: This roll was already applied to {target}. Apply it again?
repeat.applied: {user} already applied this roll to {target}. Apply it again?
repeat.failed: {user}'s attempt to apply this roll to {target} failed. Check {target}'s HP before applying it again. Apply it now?
repeat.uncertain: {user}'s attempt to apply this roll to {target} was interrupted, so it may already have changed HP. Check {target}'s HP. Apply it again?

pf2e-pending-damage.unsupported: PF2e Pending Damage could not start: the Foundry, PF2e, or Toolbelt integration is unsupported. See the console and module README.
pf2e-pending-damage.toolbeltRequired: PF2e Pending Damage requires active PF2e Toolbelt 3.56.3 or newer within versions 3–4.
pf2e-pending-damage.wrapperRequired: PF2e Pending Damage requires active libWrapper.
pf2e-pending-damage.handlerConflict: PF2e Pending Damage detected another pending damage handler in Toolbelt. Install a supported PF2e Toolbelt release before enabling this module.
pf2e-pending-damage.enableTargetHelper: Enable PF2e Toolbelt's Target Helper and Add Targets to Messages to use the pending damage window.
pf2e-pending-damage.socketUnavailable: PF2e Pending Damage can't reach other users' clients, so only you can apply damage. If you just installed it, return to Setup and launch the world again.

sync.noGM: No GM is connected, so damage can't be applied safely. Nothing was changed. Try again once a GM has joined.
sync.timeout: The GM's client didn't respond, so nothing was changed. Make sure the GM has PF2e Pending Damage enabled and everyone reloaded after updating it.
sync.version: Your PF2e Pending Damage version differs from the GM's. Everyone should reload (F5).
sync.failed: Couldn't apply damage to {target}: {error}. Check {target}'s HP; a GM can apply it again from the chat card.
sync.invalid: Couldn't apply damage to {target}: {error}. Nothing was changed.
sync.unrecorded: Damage was applied to {target}, but the GM's client hasn't recorded it yet. It will be recorded when the GM responds.
sync.changed: The damage roll or target changed before it could be applied. Nothing was changed.
sync.busy: {user} is already applying this roll to {target}.
sync.superseded: {user} applied this roll to {target} while you were confirming. Nothing was changed.
sync.interrupted: An earlier attempt to apply this roll to {target} was interrupted. Ask the GM to check HP and apply it again from the chat card.
sync.hidden: You can't see this damage roll.
sync.missing: This damage roll or {target} no longer exists.
sync.slow: Your connection to the GM is too slow to apply damage safely right now. Nothing was changed; try again.
